decisions: Cover143 catalogue types; incompatible types deferred with a specific reason.
All TownKit placements retain native import scale [1,1,1]; reposition for fit without resizing source assets.
No random runtime placement, autoload, new interaction or save migration.
Native tree helpers replace exactly the named old trunk shapes; changed collision requires fresh native validation.

phases.name: Selective import

phases.name: Static editable zone composition

phases.name: Native acceptance

phases.name: Handoff
